messages:
maria.ng: Quick report: found a repro where Go SDK generator emits duplicate tokens when our auth token rotates mid-stream. Minimal sampleapp and logs below.

alex.p: Yikes. Can you paste the minimal client and the log snippet?

maria.ng: Client sketch:
```go
ctx := context.Background()
gen, _ := client.Generate(ctx, sdk.GenerateRequest{Model: "fastgen", Prompt: "The quick brown"})
for gen.Next() { fmt.Print(gen.Token()) }
```
Logs around rotate:
```
15:10:01 auth refresh start
15:10:02 auth refresh ok
15:10:02 stream: reconnecting (reason=auth-refresh)
15:10:02 stream: resumed from seq=58
15:10:02 stream: emit seq=57 token="brown"
15:10:02 stream: emit seq=58 token=" fox"
```
You can see seq=57 re-emitted.

kevin.h: Sounds like client resumes from lastSeenSeq inclusive, server also replays inclusive -> overlap. Two fixes: client dedupe with seq metadata OR use opaque resume token so server can resume exclusive.

sophie.t: API impact: exposing seq on Token() is awkward ergonomics-wise. Better: add ResumeToken on Generator (opaque string) and an opt-in WithResumeStrategy(ctx, ResumeExclusive) option. Leave default behavior unchanged.

alex.p: Agree. Also add a tiny sampleapp showing how to call WithResumeStrategy and how to handle dedupe if people want it.

maria.ng: I'll open a small repro repo and WIP PR. Short-term workaround: users can filter duplicates if they keep lastSeen string; but not great.

ci-bot: CI: go-sdk/generate tests failing: `gen-auth-rotate_test` - https://ci.redwood.example/build/9999

alex.p: OK, can one of you draft a 1-pager ADR (server resume semantics + SDK opt-in) and the sampleapp. We'll iterate quickly and get tests green.

kevin.h: I'll prototype server-side exclusive resume token semantics and add unit tests that assert no overlap.

sophie.t: I'll write the SDK change checklist: additive fields, opt-in flag, and sample migration notes.

maria.ng: Thanks. I'll link the repro PR when it's ready.
